scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason: The checkpoint analyzer could not compare the confirmation total to the prior bag total after checkout.
scenarios.diagnosis: The test reached the confirmation page but lost or did not record the €17.90 total shown in the bag before it tried to compare the two pages.
scenarios.suggestion: Update the checkout test to save the bag total when it is displayed and pass that saved value to the confirmation-page check. The captured pages show €17.90 in both places.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed that the initial order summary showed €4.90 shipping and a €49.40 total.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once.
The bag now shows free shipping and a €51.00 total.

Applied the promo code successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.
